title: Controlled eviction slew and tenant grace matrix for soft failover
author: Priya Kapoor
release_notes: Introduce a controlled eviction rate limiter (eviction-slew) and a tenant_grace_matrix that provides temporary SLO slack based on tier and recent error budget; adds telemetry and a rollback guard. Backwards-compatible toggle via feature flag.
description: Motivation: During recent regional overload incidents customers observed sudden eviction storms that caused broad KV cache thrashing and increased tail latency. This PR implements a soft, staged eviction strategy that reduces user-visible disruption by smoothing eviction rollouts and granting short-term grace to tenants based on a configurable grace matrix. Design: 1) eviction_slew: a rate limiter that caps eviction actions per-node and per-region with an exponential warmup when a new eviction window opens. 2) tenant_grace_matrix: maps tenant SLO tiers, recent error-budget burn, and request criticality to a short grace budget that defers non-essential evictions for that tenant. 3) rollback_guard: telemetry-driven circuit that automatically reverts to aggressive eviction mode if queue pressure worsens beyond safety thresholds. 4) safe-kv-drain: deferred KV drain path that prefers prefix-preserving preserves and drains hot-kv entries last to avoid cache stampedes. Implementation notes: feature gated under runtime.eviction.slew and runtime.eviction.grace_matrix; comprehensive unit and integration tests added; opt-in canary via perf-canary job. Checklist: ran unit tests locally, added canary job (perf-canary), updated telemetry dashboards, added docs snippet for operators, feature flags set to off by default. Commit summary: initial implementation of eviction_slew and tenant_grace_matrix; add RBAC checks and metrics; fix race in per-node limiter; instrument rollback_guard; add integration tests and canary pipeline config; address reviewer feedback (telemetry label + metrics naming). CI: initial run failed a flakey integration test (race on limiter refill), fixed with a small mutex and retried; final CI passed. Merge: squash+merge after approvals. Context: addresses ENG-4123 (soft-failover reliability) and SRE-78 (eviction storm mitigation).
